src: single red marker pixel s on the grid border
path: straight inward ray from s; whenever the ray first hits a perpendicular blue/green bar, turn one cell before it and pass just outside the bar: blue chooses the left side relative to travel, green chooses the right side; then resume the same inward direction from the shifted lane until the boundary
trajectory: paint every background pixel on the ray and detour segments red
transform: keep the source marker and all blue/green bars unchanged
